admission.goal: A public decoder frame-processing call accepts stream data and populates the internal FLAC bitreader used by residual decoding.
admission.predicate: a0.hit && a1.hit && a1.time > a0.time && a0.input == a1.br && (a1.words > 0 || a1.bytes > 0)

root.goal: Rice residual block decoding reaches a state where no complete or partial buffered word remains even though more residual values are still expected.

target.goal: The same exhausted bitreader position is then used as an index for a buffer read in the next residual-decode iteration.
target.predicate: t0.hit && t0.time > root.r0.time && t0.cwords == root.r0.cwords && t0.words == root.r0.words && root.r0.bytes == 0 && root.r0.remaining > 0
